customerEntityUid.description: Verifone allocated ID for the customer this order is for (packages and bundles are associated with this entity).

requestedDate.description: The requested date for this order.

additionalOrderData.description: Input data which maybe required for the country/business unit to to complete the order. For example some countries require a VAT ID, or different legal forms of business, this will be defined by Verifone if needed for your integration
